faq.q: Was sind gute Spiele für ältere Erwachsene?
faq.a: Gute Spiele sind einfach, vertraut und ohne Druck: große Bilder zum Zuordnen, Sortieren, leichte Puzzles, das Ergänzen bekannter Sprichwörter, Ausmalen, Bilder-Bingo und Gesprächskarten. Sie passen zu vielen älteren Erwachsenen, auch zu Menschen, die mit Demenz leben. Die beste Wahl ist das Spiel, das der Person heute gefällt. Vermeiden Sie Timer, Punkte und alles, was sich wie eine Prüfung anfühlt.

Ɛ̃. Fefe ɖesiaɖe kple esi woate ŋu ata ɖe Creative Activities dzi la nye femaxee, akɔntabubu, asidede agbalẽ te alo kɔpi aɖeke mele eme o. Fefeawo zɔna le nyatakakadzraɖoƒea le telefon, tablɛt alo kɔmpiuta dzi.

faq.q: Ðe ahɔhɔ̃mefefewo xea mɔ na tagbɔdɔ?
faq.a: Es ist kein Spiel bekannt, das Demenz nachweislich verhindert, und Creative Activities behauptet nicht, etwas zu behandeln oder zu verhindern. Unsere Spiele dienen dem Vergnügen und der gemeinsamen Zeit, und keine Aktivitätsseite macht gesundheitsbezogene Aussagen.

faq.q: Ðe fefe siawo sɔ na amesi ŋu Alzheimer-dɔlélea lea?
faq.a: Ɛ̃. Alzheimer-dɔlélee nye nusi gbɔ tagbɔdɔléle tsona wu, eye wowɔa fefeawo ɖe eta: nɔnɔmetata gã siwo nɔa ɖeɖefiam, tiatia ʋɛ aɖewo, eye naneke meli si dzi woaɖo ŋkui alo agblẽ o. Nya nyanyɛwo ƒe sɔsɔ, wo ɖoɖo ɖe wo nɔewo nu kple wo wuwu nɔ te ɖe sidzedze si woxɔ ɣeyiɣi didi aɖe dzi tsɔ wu be woanɔ te ɖe nu yeye siwo wosrɔ̃ dzi.

faq.q: Ðe ame aɖe si ŋu tagbɔdɔléle si va emegbe ate ŋu awɔ dɔ siawoa?
faq.a: Zi geɖe la, ẽ, ne ame aɖe nɔa wo xa. Dze egɔme kple Di nu ma ke kple nɔnɔmetata eve, Nɔnɔmetata eve siwo ŋu tile ene le, amadede ƒe axa alo gbɔgbɔtsixetsixe ƒe ɖiɖiɖeme. Na wòanɔ kpuie, dze woƒe ŋgɔdonya yome eye nàtɔ ne woɖu nu wòsu.

faq.q: Ðe nye nyatakakawo nye ame ŋutɔ tɔa?
faq.a: Akɔntabubu kple boblododo aɖeke mele nyatakakadzraɖoƒea o. Míezãa Google Analytics tsɔ sea axa siwo dzi woʋuna la gɔme. Foto siwo nètia na Foto eveawo la dzena le wò web-browser me ko eye womedaa wo ɖe Internet dzi gbeɖe o.

Ame sia ame si kpɔa ame bubu ŋu: fofo, mama, vi, srɔ̃, xɔse ƒo, alo ame si ŋusẽ gbɔ dementia le ɖe. Ƒomewo, ame siwo le ƒe geɖe ŋu, kple dɔwɔlawo le dzidzɔkpɔ ŋu ate ŋu aɖo nuŋlɔɖea ɖeka sia ŋu.

Nusi míexɔ xɔse ɖe ŋu

Dzidzɔkpɔ ƒe ŋusẽ nye ɣeyiɣi ɖeka sia: nuƒoƒo, dzidzɔ, dzidzɔ si ɖoa ame ŋu ne míeɖo wɔnaŋuwo ɖeka ɖe wo dzi, alo ame ɖeka nɔ nu ƒom ɖe ame bubu ŋu. Menye be woadi ame ɖe ƒe ɖe alo be woakpɔ nu ame aɖe ŋu alo be woatsɔ ŋutinya naneke aɖe ŋu o.

Nuwɔwɔ geɖewo ƒe dzidzɔkpɔ siwo nye tɔ sɔ kple tadedeagu, ƒomevi kple dzidzɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣiwo. Ne ame aɖe ye tsi alo ŋusẽ mele eŋu alo dementia le eŋu la, esia ate ŋu ava le ele be wòanye ɖeɖeko si mate ŋu aɖe o. Míewɔ nu si gbɔ ɖe esia dzi, eye míeŋlɔ ɖe mía ŋutɔwo ŋu le nɔnɔmewo sia dzi:

  • Naneke mexɔ ɖe ta o. Ɣeyiɣi, ƒomevi, kpekpe, ŋutinya, nuwɔwɔ dzidzɔ, alo ɣeyiɣi si yina mefɔ o, le ŋutikɔkɔe ɖeka ŋu.
  • Kpɔkpɔ nu wu nu ɖoɖo. Wɔwɔ dzi, woaɖe nuwɔnawo ɖe ɖoƒe. Nuƒoƒowo ɖea ame ƒe nu ŋuti ɖoɖo, eye womebia ŋkɔwo alo ŋutinyawo ŋu o.
  • Gbɔgbɔ, nu sɔsɔ kple nu si ɖoa ɖe ɖoɖo. Nuŋlɔ gbɔgbɔ kple nuwɔnawo, nu nyuiwo kple tsi tsitsi, kple nuwɔwɔ si wɔa nu ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoƒe ɖeka.
  • Ame ƒe bubutɔwɔwɔ. Nuwɔnawo siwo le anyigba dzi ɖa kple nuƒoƒo nyuitɔ. Menye hebubu, ɖiɖi alo akpedɔ alo emoji ɖe ame yɔyɔ dzi o.
  • Mɔ si ŋu ate ŋu aɖo nu. “Ɖo nu sɔ ɖe eme” nɔa anyi ɖaa. Ɖe ame eye wòɖo nu ɖe eme la nye ŋutinya nyui.
  • Nuwɔwɔ ŋutɔ ɖe ɖoɖo. Ŋutɔ alo agbalẽ aɖeke menɔ ɖe mía si o. Nuwɔwɔ si wòɖo ɖe dzi nɔa ŋu dzi ŋutɔ ɖe ŋu wò ŋutɔ ƒe ɖoƒe.

Nusi míegblɔ be míele o

Míaƒe dzidzɔkpɔwo kple nuwɔnawo na dzidzɔ kple ɖekawɔwɔ ko. Womedea nuwɔnawo ɖe dementia alo Alzheimer’s disease kpɔ ɖa, ðe ɖe nu ƒe ŋuti, aɖe nu hɔ, dzi ɖe nu ɖa, alo ɖe nu ɖe eme o, eye ame aɖeke managawɔ nuwɔnawo ɖe esia ta o. Ne míeŋlɔ nu tso nuƒoƒo ƒe nuwɔnawo ŋu la, míegblɔa eme ɖaa ne nuŋlɔɖeɖe mele ŋusẽ gbɔ, eye míegaɖe mía ŋutɔwo dzidzɔkpɔ ɖe eme o.

Ame kawo mienye

Creative Activities nye ɖoɖo ɖeka si nye ame aɖewo ƒe ɖoɖo sue. Míenye dɔtɔwo o. Míeŋlɔa míaƒe nuŋlɔɖewo tso nuŋlɔɖeɖe siwo wokpɔ ɖa tso dɔwɔnuwo dzi, abe National Institute on Aging kple Alzheimer’s Association ene, eye nuŋlɔɖea ɖesiaɖe ɖoa míaƒe nuŋlɔɖewo ŋkɔ. Kpɔ alekae míeŋlɔa eye míedea míaƒe nuŋlɔɖewo ŋu.

Gblɔ nusi kpɔa ƒo nu nam

Míedi be míasee nusi wɔa nu na mi kple nusi womewɔa nu o, vevietɔ tso ame siwo nɔ dementia le ɖe, ƒomewo siwo kpɔa ame ŋu, kple dɔwɔlawo le dzidzɔkpɔ ŋu. Woate ŋu ade email le {email}.

editorial.description: Alekae Creative Activities dea nuŋlɔɖeɖe ɖe, nuŋlɔɖeɖe, nusi míeɖea, kple míaƒe dzidzɔkpɔ kple kpɔkpɔ nuŋlɔɖewo ŋu, kple nusiwo míamaɖo ɖo ɣeaɖe o.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.lede: Nya siwo dɔnɔdzikpɔlawo biana wu la ƒe ŋuɖoɖo kpui siwo me kɔ.

items.q: Dzidzɔkpɔ kae nyui le ame ƒe xɔsewo ŋu?
items.a: Fefe nyuitɔwo nye esiwo amewo nya nyuie, wole bɔbɔe eye nyaƒoɖeamenu aɖeke mele wo ŋu o, eye esi sɔ la nye nusianu si amea doa dzidzɔ na egbea. Nɔnɔmetatawo ƒe sɔsɔ kple nɔnɔmetata siwo wokpɔna, wo ɖoɖo ɖe hatsotsowo me, jigsaw bɔbɔewo, nya nyanyɛwo wuwu, amadede kple nɔnɔmetata bingo katã wɔa dɔ nyuie na ame geɖe. Ƒo asa na ɣeyiɣidzidzenuwo, dzesiwo kple nusianu si ase le ɖokuiwò me abe dodokpɔ ene.
Ɛ̃. Fefewo kple esiwo woate ŋu ata la katã nye esiwo woate ŋu ata femaxee, womewɔa akɔntabubu, asidede agbalẽ te, kɔpi alo boblododo aɖeke o.

items.q: Nukatae dzesiwo, dzidzenuwo alo ɣeyiɣidzidzenuwo meli o?
items.a: Duƒuƒu kple dzesiwo trɔa nuwɔna dodzidzɔname aɖe wòzua dodokpɔ, si ate ŋu ahe ŋukpe alo dziɖeleameƒo vɛ. Míetsɔa míaƒe susu nɔa vivisese kple ɣeyiɣi ɖekae ŋu, eyata naneke meli si ado kpo nu o eye àte ŋu atɔ le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me.

items.q: Mɔ̃ kawoe wɔa dɔ nyuie wu?
items.a: Telefon, tablɛt alo kɔmpiuta ɖesiaɖe si ŋu egbegbe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe le. Zi geɖe la, tablɛt si le tsitrenu le kplɔ̃ ŋue nye mɔ si dzi ame eve ate ŋu ato aƒo fefe ɖekae wu. Laptop si wotsɔ do ka kple TV wɔa dɔ nyuie na ƒuƒoƒowo.

items.q: Ðe míate ŋu atsɔ mía ŋutɔwo ƒe ƒomea ƒe fotowo aƒo fefea?
items.a: Ɛ̃. Foto eveveve trɔa foto 2 va ɖo 6 siwo nètia wòzua fefe si sɔ. Fotoawo nɔa wò web-browser me eye womedaa wo ɖe Internet dzi alo dzraa wo ɖo o.

items.q: Ɣeyiɣi didi kae wòle be dɔwɔna aɖe naxɔ?
items.a: Zi geɖe la, miniti 10 va ɖo 20 sɔ gbɔ, eye ɣeaɖewoɣi la, miniti 2 nyea dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ. Lé ŋku ɖe ɖeɖiteameŋu alo dziɖeleameƒo ƒe dzesiwo ŋu eye nàdzudzɔ esime wògakpɔtɔ le dzidzɔ kpɔm. Ga home aɖeke meli si sɔ o.

items.q: Ke ne womedi be yewoawɔ dɔwɔna aɖe o ɖe?
items.a: De bubu ao ŋu, eye nàgadze agbagba ake emegbe alo le mɔ bubu nu. Gbegbe ate ŋu atso ɖeɖiteameŋu, vevesese, kakaɖedzimanɔamesi alo ɖekematsɔleme manɔmee ko gbɔ. Kpɔ míaƒe mɔfiame si ku ɖe nusi nàwɔ ne wogblɔ be ao ŋu.

items.q: Dɔ kawoe sɔ na tagbɔdɔléle si va emegbe?
items.a: Akɔfafa kple sidzenuwo: toɖoɖo ha siwo wolɔ̃na wu, asitutu kple atike, fotowo kpɔkpɔ ɖekae, avɔ falɛfalɛ léle ɖe asi, anyinɔƒe le gota, alo nɔnɔmetatafefe bɔbɔe aɖe ŋutɔ kple ame aɖe le wo xa. Susu bubu geɖewo le míaƒe mɔfiamegbalẽ si míewɔ emegbe.

items.q: Ðe dɔwɔna aɖewo li na ƒuƒoƒowo le dɔnɔdzikpɔƒe aɖea?
items.a: Ɛ̃. Picture bingo ƒe agbalẽvi siwo woate ŋu ata kple ame si ƒoa ka le screen dzi le, eye Finish the saying kple Conversation cards wɔa dɔ nyuie xexlẽ sesĩe. Míaƒe belélenameƒewo ƒe ƒuƒoƒowo ƒe mɔfiamegbalẽa ƒo nu tso ƒuƒoƒo ƒe lolome, zikpuiwo kple tɔtrɔ ɖe ŋutete vovovowo ŋu ŋu.

items.q: Ðe fefewo ate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe tagbɔdɔléle nu alo ana wòanɔ blewua?
items.a: Womeɖe fefe aɖeke fia be wòaxe mɔ ɖe tagbɔdɔléle nu o, eye míaƒe fefewo megblɔa nya ma tɔgbe aɖeke o. Sidzedze ƒe ʋuʋu le hadomenuwɔna me ɖe viɖe sue aɖewo fia le numekuku me na amesiwo ŋu tagbɔdɔléle si nu mesẽ o va ɖo esi mesẽ o le, gake ema to vovo na fefe si xea mɔ na dɔléle. Míewɔa fefewo hena vivisese kple kadodo.

items.q: Ðe woate ŋu axe mɔ ɖe tagbɔdɔléle nua?
items.a: Menye kakaɖedzitɔe o. Numekukuwo ɖee fia be lãmesẽ kple agbenɔnɔ ŋuti nu 14 do ƒome kple tagbɔdɔléle ƒe afɔku, abe tosese, ʋusɔgbɔdɔ, kamemademade kple ame ɖokui ɖeɖe ɖe aga le hadome ene. Wo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ ate ŋu aɖe afɔkua dzi akpɔtɔ na ame aɖewo, gake ame geɖe siwo wɔa nusianu nyuie la gakpɔtɔ xɔa tagbɔdɔ. Menye ame aɖeke ƒe vodadae wònye gbeɖe o.

items.q: Ðe nutsitsidɔ ɣeaɖewoɣi nyo na ahɔhɔ̃a ƒe lãmesẽa?
items.a: Amegbetɔwo ƒe kpeɖodziwo mesɔ gbɔ o eye wodo ŋgɔ, eye numekukuawo ƒe akpa gãtɔ ku ɖe lãwo ŋu. Nutsitsidɔ ate ŋu anye afɔku na ame tsitsiwo, vevietɔ ne wozã suklidɔtikewo alo lolo dzi ɖeɖe kpɔtɔ le vome, eye womekafui na amesiwo ŋu tagbɔdɔléle le o. Ðo dze kple ɖɔkta hafi nàtrɔ alesi nèɖua nui.

Dze egɔme kple tile gã ene kple nɔnɔmetata nyanyɛwo. Na nɔnɔmetatawo nadze, alo ɣla wo ne esia na wò dzi dze eme. Gentle mode mekpɔa ɣeyiɣidzidzenu, dzesi alo tohehe aɖeke o. Tia tile 4, 6, 8 alo 12.

Tia ƒomea ƒe fotowo kple wò mɔ̃a ƒe fotoɖemɔ̃. Dɔdamɔnua dzraa kɔpi suewo ɖo hena eƒe dɔwɔnawo. Mewɔa wò agbalẽdzraɖoƒea ƒe scan alo trɔa wò foto gbãtɔwo o, eye wòléa foto siwo ade 24 ɖe nudzraɖoƒe ɖeka.

Kpɔ nɔnɔmetata ɖeka le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me. Nya siwo woate ŋu abia tso ame si la kpea dzeɖoɖo evɔ womebia tso ame aɖeke si be wòaɖo ŋku ŋkɔwo dzi alo ana ŋuɖoɖo nyuitɔ o. Kpɔkpɔ dzro ko sɔ gbɔ.

Akɔntabubu aɖeke meli o, fotowo ƒe wɔwɔ ɖekae ƒe dɔwɔƒe aɖeke meli o

Ƒomea ƒe fotowo ƒe kɔpiwo nɔa dɔwɔnua me le mɔ̃a dzi. Àte ŋu aɖe kɔpiawo ɖa evɔ màtutu gbãtɔawo ɖa o. Mɔ̃a ƒe kɔpiwo ate ŋu anye dɔwɔnua ƒe nyatakakawo. Xlẽ nya sia app ƒe ameŋunyatakakawo ŋuti ɖoɖo, kple app ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu zɔna to afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe me.

reasons.sayings: Ili ma kple kpɔ̃ɖi aɖeke o le azɔ. Ne wòle kpɔ̃ɖi dzi la, nuwuwu sia nuwuwu ɖeka dzi ɖe enu ɖekae, eye gbɔgbɔ̃ ɖoɖo "Show the ending" ɖe gbɔ la matsɔa ŋu nɔ o. Kpɔ̃ɖi ɖe screen dzi ŋutɔ, alo gblɔ nya ʋeʋẽwo si mialé ŋu ɖe nu ɖeka ɖeka kple ɖekae.
